name: Dr. Shreya Gopal Agarwal
notes: NOT FOUND - all fields deliberately left blank. Five distinct searches produced no page anywhere on the open web for a Dr Shreya Gopal Agarwal in medical oncology at AIG Hospitals, or indeed in Hyderabad at all: (1) full name + medical oncology + AIG + Hyderabad; (2) domain-restricted search of aighospitals.com on 'Shreya Agarwal medical oncologist', which returned the AIG medical-oncology listing pages and OTHER oncologists (Dr Indraja Siripurapu, Dr Avinash Bonda) but never her, in any URL family; (3) 'Dr Shreya Agarwal' + medical oncologist + Hyderabad + AIG; (4) exact-phrase "Shreya Gopal Agarwal" + oncologist; (5) spelling variants 'Dr Shreya Agrawal' / 'Dr Shreya Gopal' + oncology + Hyderabad + AIG + LinkedIn. The AIG Gachibowli oncology rosters on Practo, HexaHealth, Skedoc and Credihealth were all surfaced and none carries her name. SAME-NAME PEOPLE FOUND AND CORRECTLY EXCLUDED, none of them this doctor: Dr Shreya Agarwal MD, paediatric haematologist-oncologist at UCSF Benioff Children's Hospitals, San Francisco (right specialty family, wrong country and wrong sub-specialty); Dr Shreya Agrawal, Consultant Anaesthesiologist and Pain Physician at CONTINENTAL Hospitals, Hyderabad (right city, wrong specialty, wrong hospital); Dr Shreya Goyal, medical oncologist in Brooklyn NY; and an unrelated 'Shreya Agarwal - Garden City Hospital' LinkedIn account. Nothing was recorded from any of them and no contact, URL or role was carried across. HUMAN ACTION SUGGESTED: the name may be transliterated differently in the source workbook (e.g. a compound Indian name where 'Gopal' is a middle/father's name), she may be a junior/registrar-grade doctor who is not published on the hospital roster, or the AIG affiliation may be stale. Only the AIG doctor-directory landing page is cited as provenance for the band, since that is the page whose absence of her name is the evidence.
